title: A wearable sensor-based kinematic dataset collected under standardized rehabilitation tasks from 120 post-stroke patients
notes: Downloaded release inspected on 2026-08-31. Longitudinal identity linkage is not exposed, one training NPY is corrupt, 2,454/5,994 assessment IMU arrays contain all-zero acceleration, and the released acceleration scale (gravity near 1 with values reaching +/-16) conflicts with the paper's m/s2 and +/-2 g declarations. Do not use without author clarification.
